name: fieldwise
description: Crop advisory platform for Indian smallholder farmers

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @fieldwise/shared && npm run db:setup -w @fieldwise/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @fieldwise/api" "npm run dev -w @fieldwise/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fieldwise/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present

//overrides: rollup -> @rollup/wasm-node: same Rollup, WebAssembly build. Windows Application Control blocks the native rollup .node binary on some machines.
